mnemonic.meaning: 実 reality + 行 carry out: making it real by doing it.
mnemonic.reading: "JIK-KOU!" (じっこう) Just go: put the plan into action.

examples.ja: 計画を実行に移した。
examples.en: We put the plan into action.

items.note: Also "run" for a computer program. 実行力 = the ability to get things done.

mnemonic.meaning: 雇 = 戸 (door) + 隹 (bird): letting a bird in your door to work for you.
mnemonic.reading: "YA, TOE!" (やとう) You hire someone to fix your toe.

examples.ja: その店は学生を三人雇った。
examples.en: The shop hired three students.

items.note: 雇用 (こよう) = employment, in formal writing.

mnemonic.meaning: PITTARI: "PIT, TARRY": it fits snugly into the pit.

examples.ja: この靴はサイズがぴったりだ。
examples.en: These shoes are the perfect size.

items.note: Also for timing and suitability: ぴったりの仕事 (a perfect job).

mnemonic.meaning: 要 essential + 素 element: an essential element.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU, SO!" (ようそ) You're so essential.

examples.ja: 成功には運の要素もある。
examples.en: Luck is also a factor in success.

items.note: Formal. Like "factor" in English.

items.pos: noun, する verb, な adjective

mnemonic.meaning: 安 peaceful + 定 fixed: settled and calm.
mnemonic.reading: "AN, TAY!" (あんてい) Anne stays steady.

examples.ja: 安定した仕事を探している。
examples.en: I'm looking for a stable job.

items.note: 不安定 = unstable.

mnemonic.meaning: OYOSO: "Oh, you so?" Roughly so.

examples.ja: 駅まで歩いておよそ十分かかる。
examples.en: It takes about ten minutes to walk to the station.

items.note: Formal; だいたい / 約 are close. With a negative it means "not at all": およそ関係ない.

mnemonic.meaning: 一 one + 種 kind: one kind of.
mnemonic.reading: "ISSHU!" (いっしゅ) One sort of shoe.

examples.ja: これは一種の病気だ。
examples.en: This is a kind of illness.

items.note: 一種の〜 = a sort of.

mnemonic.meaning: 風 wind + 景 scenery: what the wind sweeps over.
mnemonic.reading: "FOO, KAY!" (ふうけい) "Phew, okay, nice view."

examples.ja: 窓から美しい風景が見える。
examples.en: You can see beautiful scenery from the window.

items.note: Also a scene from everyday life: 町の風景. 景色 (けしき) is very similar.

mnemonic.meaning: 積 accumulate + 極 extreme + 的 -ic: piling on to the extreme. Going for it.
mnemonic.reading: "SEKKYOKU!" (せっきょく) Set, kick, you go for it.

examples.ja: 彼は何にでも積極的に参加する。
examples.en: He actively takes part in everything.

items.note: Opposite: 消極的 (しょうきょくてき, passive).

mnemonic.meaning: 明 clear + 確 certain: clear and certain.
mnemonic.reading: "MAY, KAKU!" (めいかく) May writes (書く) clearly.

examples.ja: 目標を明確にしよう。
examples.en: Let's make our goals clear.

items.note: Formal. はっきり is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 地 ground + 位 rank: where you stand in the ranks.
mnemonic.reading: "CHEE, EE!" (ちい) Small (小さい) people climb to high status.

examples.ja: 彼は会社で高い地位にある。
examples.en: He holds a high position in the company.

items.note: Social position, not a physical place.

mnemonic.meaning: 表 surface + 面 face: the face on the surface.
mnemonic.reading: "HYOU, MEN!" (ひょうめん) The leopard men slide across the surface.

examples.ja: 月の表面には穴がたくさんある。
examples.en: There are many craters on the moon's surface.

items.note: Figurative too: 表面上 = on the surface, outwardly.

mnemonic.meaning: 始 begin: the start of something.
mnemonic.reading: "HAJIMARI!" (はじまり) Same as はじめ: the beginning.

examples.ja: それが二人の恋の始まりだった。
examples.en: That was the beginning of their romance.

items.note: Noun from 始まる. 始め is also "beginning".

mnemonic.meaning: 地 ground + 方 direction: an area of land in one direction.
mnemonic.reading: "CHEE, HOU!" (ちほう) Cheese from the countryside.

examples.ja: 地方の小さな町で育った。
examples.en: I grew up in a small town in the countryside.

items.note: Often "outside the big cities". 関東地方 = the Kanto region.

mnemonic.meaning: UKKARI: "Oops, carry" the wrong bag. A careless slip.

examples.ja: うっかり傘を電車に忘れた。
examples.en: I carelessly left my umbrella on the train.

items.note: Mistakes from not paying attention. わざと is the opposite (on purpose).

mnemonic.meaning: 性 nature + 質 quality: the natural quality of something.
mnemonic.reading: "SAY, SHITSU!" (せいしつ) Say what its nature is.

examples.ja: この金属は熱に強い性質がある。
examples.en: This metal has the property of withstanding heat.

items.note: Used for people's temperament and for properties of things. 性格 is just personality.

mnemonic.meaning: 分 divide: things divide into parts.
mnemonic.reading: "WAKA-RE-RU." (わかれる) Like 分かる; when you understand, ideas separate clearly.

examples.ja: 道が二つに分かれている。
examples.en: The road splits in two.

items.note: 別れる (also わかれる) = to part from a person. 意見が分かれる = opinions differ.

mnemonic.meaning: 出 go out + 会 meet: going out and meeting someone.
mnemonic.reading: DE (out) + AI (meet, like 会う): (であい)

examples.ja: 二人の出会いは大学だった。
examples.en: The two of them met at university.

items.note: Often a meaningful first meeting. 出会い系 = dating sites.

mnemonic.meaning: 案 = 安 (peaceful) + 木 (wood/desk): sitting peacefully at a desk making a plan.
mnemonic.reading: "AN!" (あん) An idea pops up.

examples.ja: いい案が浮かんだ。
examples.en: A good idea came to mind.

items.note: 案外 (unexpectedly), 提案 (proposal), 案内 (guidance).

mnemonic.meaning: 実 reality + 現 appear: it appears in reality.
mnemonic.reading: "JITSU, GEN!" (じつげん) It's really (実は) happening.

examples.ja: ついに夢が実現した。
examples.en: My dream finally came true.

items.note: 夢を実現する = make a dream come true.

mnemonic.meaning: 経 pass through: time passing through.
mnemonic.reading: "HEH-RU!" (へる) Same sound as 減る (decrease). Time passes, your days decrease.

examples.ja: 長い年月を経て、二人は再会した。
examples.en: After many long years, the two met again.

items.note: Formal and written. 経て = through, via. 減る (へる) means to decrease.

mnemonic.meaning: 取 take + 上 up: take something up.
mnemonic.reading: TORI (take) + AGERU (raise): (とりあげる)

examples.ja: ニュースでその問題が取り上げられた。
examples.en: That issue was covered on the news.

items.note: 3 senses: pick up an object; feature a topic; confiscate.

mnemonic.meaning: 重 heavy + 大 big: heavy and big. Serious.
mnemonic.reading: "JUU, DIE!" (じゅうだい) Ten (十) people die: very serious.

examples.ja: これは重大な問題だ。
examples.en: This is a serious problem.

items.note: Stronger than 大切. Often bad news: 重大な事故.

mnemonic.meaning: 解 solve + 釈 explain: untangling the meaning.
mnemonic.reading: "KAI, SHAKU!" (かいしゃく) Kai explains the shakuhachi flute's song.

examples.ja: この文にはいろいろな解釈がある。
examples.en: This sentence can be interpreted in many ways.

items.note: How you read the meaning, not translation (翻訳).

mnemonic.meaning: 一 one + 致 bring about: everything comes to one.
mnemonic.reading: "ICCHI!" (いっち) Two itches in the same spot.

examples.ja: 二人の意見が一致した。
examples.en: The two of them agreed.

items.note: 指紋が一致する = the fingerprints match.

mnemonic.meaning: 挑 challenge + 戦 fight: daring to fight.
mnemonic.reading: "CHOU, SEN!" (ちょうせん) Chew a thousand (千) times: a challenge.

examples.ja: 新しいことに挑戦したい。
examples.en: I want to try something new.

items.note: Positive: taking on a challenge. Not "difficulty" (that's 課題 or 難しさ).

mnemonic.meaning: 高 high: it becomes higher.
mnemonic.reading: "TAKA, MARU!" (たかまる) Your ball (丸) rises high.

examples.ja: 試合が近づき、緊張が高まってきた。
examples.en: As the match approached, the tension rose.

items.note: Intransitive (it rises). The partner 高める means you raise it.

mnemonic.meaning: 高 high: you make it higher.
mnemonic.reading: "TAKA, MERU!" (たかめる) Take (たか) a mail (メール) course to raise your skills.

examples.ja: 練習して技術を高めたい。
examples.en: I want to improve my skills with practice.

items.note: Transitive (you raise it). 高まる is the intransitive partner.

mnemonic.meaning: 分 divide + 析 split: splitting it into parts.
mnemonic.reading: "BUN, SEKI!" (ぶんせき) You split a bun in your seat (席) to analyse it.

examples.ja: データを分析した結果、問題が分かった。
examples.en: Analysing the data revealed the problem.

items.note: Formal and academic.

mnemonic.meaning: 生 life + 涯 limit: life up to its limit.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOW, GUY!" (しょうがい) The guy's lifetime show. 障害 (obstacle) sounds the same.

examples.ja: 彼は生涯を研究に捧げた。
examples.en: He devoted his whole life to research.

items.note: Formal. 一生 is everyday. 生涯学習 = lifelong learning.
